protocol.load_forecast: 7-day seasonal-naive when available; selected on January only

protocol.curtail_semantics: PV-only; unused paid contract is separate

scenario_count.interpretation: formal-period realized-policy stability only; K=3 was predeclared and is not selected by these formal results; not theoretical VSS/VOI
